row.evidence: Domo's Knowledge Base documents SCIM endpoints at {YourDomoSubdomain}.domo.com/api/identity/v1/scim for users and directory groups, while the pricing page offers only a 30-day free trial and quote-based Custom Pricing ("Only pay for what you use").
row.notes: Quote-only: Domo sells on credit-based consumption pricing with no public plan table (30-day free trial, then Custom Pricing via sales); which contract terms include SCIM or SSO is not published. Progress Software has acquired Domo's AI and Data Platform business; the product is still sold as Domo. SCIM is a generic SCIM 2.0 API configured on the IdP side with a Domo access token (Okta and Entra mappings documented; the Okta OIN and Entra gallery apps are SSO only). Setting active=false or DELETE deletes the user, and deletion fails if the user owns DataSets or DataFlows. SCIM manages only directory groups. JIT via SAML/OIDC SSO is on by default; deleting a user in the IdP does not delete them in Domo without SCIM or the API.

auth.token_source: Domo access token generated in Admin (Authentication > Access tokens), owned by a user with Manage All Users / Roles / Groups grants
auth.notes: Also accepts X-Domo-Developer-Token header. Version 2.0 inferred from the SCIM 2.0 schema URNs in the examples.

operations.notes: PATCH Users is marked Beta. 'deactivate' (active=false) actually deletes the user.

deprovision.data_retained: User is deleted; deletion fails while the user owns DataSets or DataFlows, which must be reassigned first.

custom.how: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:custom:2.0:User customAttributes [{key, values}] for attributes predefined in Domo; Domo extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:domo:2.0:User adds hireDate and employeeLocation

roles.how: Single-valued SCIM roles attribute carrying a Domo role ID

limitations.text: name.givenName / name.familyName are ignored; Domo uses displayName.
Users who own DataSets or DataFlows cannot be deleted (or set inactive) via SCIM.
Entra cannot sync multi-valued custom attributes.
Okta keeps Domo IDs per app, so one Okta app per Domo instance is recommended.

auth.notes: OAuth2 client-credentials grant with a client ID and secret from the Developer Portal.

capabilities.notes: assign_roles via the role property (Admin, Privileged, Participant). No DELETE user endpoint appears in the User API spec.

endpoints.purpose: Add a user to a group
Remove a user from a group

okta.notes: OIN page markup has SAML, SWA and OIDC checked, SCIM and provisioning unchecked. Domo's SCIM doc gives Okta attribute mappings for a SCIM app configured on the Okta side.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SAML SSO with JIT; no Entra provisioning tutorial (domo-provisioning-tutorial 404). Domo's SCIM doc gives Entra mappings.

google.notes: Domo's guide selects Domo from the Google Admin SAML app list; source is Domo's page, not Google's.

open_questions: Which Domo contracts/editions include SCIM and SSO is not published (pricing is quote-only).
Whether SCIM deletion frees a licence (Domo advertises unlimited users on consumption pricing) is not documented.
SCIM and API rate limits are not documented.
Supported SCIM filter attributes/operators and max page size are not documented.
No user DELETE endpoint is listed in the public User API spec, though the Remove Users article points to 'the Domo API' for deletion.
